rows.note: This is the all-purpose everyday choice for making someone feel embarrassed or humiliated.

example.jyutping: gin6 si6 ling6 ngo5 hou2 gaam3 gaai3

rows.note: Use this when the person is vexed, annoyed, or made angry rather than publicly embarrassed.

example.english: Your constant lateness can mortify me.
example.traditional: 你成日遲到，真係激嬲我喇。
example.jyutping: nei5 seng4 jat6 ci4 dou3 zan1 hai6 gik1 nau1 ngo5 laa3

rows.note: Use this for deliberately suppressing bodily desires or appetites as an act of abstinence or self-discipline.

example.english: They meditate to mortify their desires.
example.jyutping: keoi5 kaau3 daa2 zo6 lai4 haak1 zai3 juk6 mong6
